description: The beta checklist (ADR 0064, docs/BETA_ONBOARDING_SPEC.md §7). The backend seeds it once into each tester's account as a normal project (`project`, one open task per item) and measures from the account's own data which items the tester used. GET /v1/beta answers only the Today card copy. The site's /beta page and the welcome mail read the same items. English only: the beta is English. A title links its key words to the septena.app page that explains them, as Markdown links ([Do](/workflows/do)); the seeded task gets the plain words and one reference per link, the site and the welcome mail draw the links.

copy.cardBody: Thanks for testing Septena. Your checklist is the Septena beta project in your list.

project.title: Septena beta
project.notes:
Thanks for testing Septena. Each task here is one part of the app I want your notes on, and its notes say what to try. Tick a task when you have tried it. Delete the ones you don’t care about: this project is yours, like any other.

When something breaks, confuses you or works well, tell me through Support at https://septena.app/support?from=beta. Say what you tried and what you expected.

The beta notes which of these parts you used and when. It never reads what you wrote.

items.title: Sort your [Inbox](/workflows/capture) into [Today](/workflows/today)
items.try: Capture a few tasks, then move them from the Inbox at the top of Today into Today, an area or a project.

items.title: [Do](/workflows/do) one task
items.try: Pick one task to Do and work from it. Check that it stays with you on every screen.

items.title: Use a [second device](/help/sync)
items.try: Sign in on another device. Change a task on one and check that the change arrives on the other.

items.title: Let a few tasks [fade](/workflows/fade)
items.try: Leave some tasks alone for a while. They fade, and once a week Septena asks if you still want them.

items.title: Connect your [agent](/agents)
items.try: Connect Claude or another agent and give it one task you can check.

items.title: [Review](/workflows/agent-delegation) and [stop](/help/agent-controls) an agent
items.try: Answer its question, then Accept or Send back its work in Review. Press Stop on a task, or Pause all agents.

items.title: [Discuss](/workflows/discuss) a task
items.try: Open a task and press Discuss. Talk it through and see what it suggests.

items.title: [Move in](/moving-in) from another app
items.try: Bring your tasks over from the app you use now. Tell me what came across wrong.

items.title: Add a task with [Siri or Shortcuts](/help/siri-and-shortcuts)
items.try: Add a task with Siri or a Shortcut, or bring your Reminders into the Inbox.

items.title: [Capture](/workflows/capture) from anywhere
items.try: Add a task from wherever you are: Quick Entry, Quick Add or the share sheet.
